title: AAES evidence pack manifest (aaes.evidence-pack/1)
description: The examiner index of one AAES evidence pack directory. Specification: https://aaes.ai/spec.html

export_schema.description: Schema of the bound export: only aaes.export/v2 is supported. The manifest retains its independently versioned aaes.evidence-pack/1 identifier.

population.description: Plain-language statement of what the pack is evidence for; narrower than the whole agent estate by design.

does_not_cover.description: Explicit exclusions from the pack's evidentiary scope; every pack carries them.

verifier_binary.description: Optional, but required together with verifier_sha256 when a verifier binary is bundled. A checksum stored beside a binary does not independently authenticate it.

verifier_sha256.description: Optional, but required together with verifier_binary.
